ASUS Belgium lists the exact Belgian-keyboard 2026 SKU at €4749 including VAT with two years warranty. Exact specifications prove Panther Lake 386H, RTX 5080 at 135W Turbo/160W Manual, soldered 32GB maximum, 1TB, two M.2 positions, full-P3 OLED, TB4 plus second USB-C, two USB-A and no RJ45. Reviews praise its premium aluminium build, large touchpad, quiet 0dB light-load mode and exceptionally strong battery, but those strengths cannot cure the hard GPU-power, RJ45, memory and budget failures.
